summary:
[  edit  ]
The Audio Device Out  CHOP  sends audio to any of the attached audio output devices using DirectSound/CoreAudio or ASIO.
The second input on the Audio Device Out  CHOP  can be used for volume control.
Tip : If you get audio popping or audio dropouts, it may be caused by your actual frame rate of your main  timeline  - some frames may take too long to compute/render. See  Time Slicing . There are four possible remedies:
The global  CHOP   Maximum Time Slice Size  may be shorter than your worst-case time steps. Its default is .2 seconds set in Edit -> Preferences -> CHOPs -> Maximum  Time Slice  Size). If any frame takes longer than the Maximum  Time Slice  Size time to draw, audio will pop.
Then the audio buffer size can be increased (the Buffer Length parameter defaults to .15 seconds) up to the Maximum  Time Slice  Size.
Optimize your networks so under no condition your frame time exceeds the audio buffer size or the maximum time slice size. You can monitor this precisely with the  Perform CHOP .
Put audio in a separate TouchDesigner process.

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Turns the audio output on or off.

parameters.label: Driver
parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select between default DirectSound/CoreAudio or ASIO drivers.

parameters.label: DirectSound
parameters.name: default
parameters.description: The default Windows audio driver (a.k.a. WDM) or macOS CoreAudio driver, depending on your OS.

parameters.label: ASIO
parameters.name: asio
parameters.description: Low-latency drivers which usually come from the hardware's manufacturer.

parameters.label: Device
parameters.name: device
parameters.description: A menu of available audio devices to output to. Selecting  default  sets the audio device to that which is selected in Windows  Control Panel >Sounds and Audio Devices>Audio>Sound Playback.

parameters.label: Error if Missing
parameters.name: errormissing
parameters.description: The  CHOP  will error if the specified device is not found.

parameters.label: Outputs
parameters.name: outputs
parameters.description: When Driver is set to ASIO on Windows or CoreAudio on macOS, this parameter lets you pick which output channels to use.

parameters.label: Buffer Length
parameters.name: bufferlength
parameters.description: The length of the audio buffer in seconds. Audio output is delayed by this amount. For example, if the Buffer Length is 0.25 then the sound will occur 250ms = 0.25 seconds later than this  CHOP  received it (to keep the buffer full). If you hear crackling or popping in the audio output, try increasing this value.

parameters.label: Adjust Speed
parameters.name: adjustspeed
parameters.description: This value controls how forcefully the output queue is modified when it grows too long or too short. A larger value recovers the queue size more quickly, but results in audible pitch changes.

parameters.label: Volume
parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: 0 = mute, 1 = full volume.

parameters.label: Pan
parameters.name: pan
parameters.description: 0 = left, 0.5 = centered, 1 = right.

parameters.label: Clamp Output
parameters.name: clampoutput
parameters.description: Clamps the output between -1 and 1 to avoid clipping and overdriving of the audio system.

parameters.label: Cycle Channels in Output
parameters.description: When True the audio channels are sent to each audio output such that no outputs are left silent. For example this allows a single channel to be output on two stereo outputs. (ASIO only).

parameters.label: Cook  Every  Frame
parameters.name: cookalways
parameters.description: Forces the  CHOP  to cook every frame. This should be checked on at all times when outputing audio. It can be turned off when the  CHOP  is not in use.

parameters.label: Stereo Mode
parameters.name: stereo
parameters.description: Set to simple stereo left/right output mode.

parameters.label: queue_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which the output buffer is being played. Ideally it should not stray far from 1.0 (normal speed).

parameters.label: queue_read_pos
parameters.description: The current read position of the queue buffer. When playing back normally it should be ramping between start and end.

parameters.label: queue_write_pos
parameters.description: The current write position of the queue buffer. When playing back normally it should be ramping between start and end.

parameters.label: queue_length
parameters.description: The total length of the audio output buffer, in seconds.

parameters.label: queue_added
parameters.description: This value reflects the size of the audio segment last added to the output buffer.

When the operator is a  Panel Component , it also cooks when a user interacts with it. When an operator cooks, it usually causes operators connected to its output to re-cook.
